description:
[Game reference] Clan score: every scoring event, its points and who earns it, plus clan settings, roles and limits. `events`: the 17 clan score events (`label`, `score` points, `who` earns them, `convar` that changes it or null when it
is fixed, `pvp`), highest first. PvP events are 0 on vanilla and have no setting. Also `convars` (clan.enabled,
clan.maxmembercount, clan.editsrequireclantable), admin `commands`, `limits` (name/message lengths), default `roles` and
the `clan_table` recipe. Vanilla PvP events (kills, deaths, Tool Cupboards) are worth 0 and have no setting. Link https://rust.wiki/clans.
name: get_clan_score_rules
title: Clan score: every scoring event, its points and who earns it, plus clan settings, roles and limits
